value.rationale: The sharp contraction is new in the Dirichlet range and its published equality classification is qualitative. This proves the exact stability spectrum on the infinite-dimensional transverse complement, identifies its unique weakest mode and recovers a local coercive remainder modulo conformal extremizers. It is an intrinsic structural stability question with a precise optimal constant, not a table lookup, parameter substitution, or arbitrary finite slice.
